description: Lists the models your API key can use (GET /v1/models) with public list prices (USD per 1M tokens, or per call). Without a key it shows the public price list. Optional filter text, e.g. "deepseek", "claude", "image". Free.

filter.description: Optional text to match in the model id or type (chat, image, video, tts, stt, embedding).
